title: Luca Leonardini — Incorruptible's 'financial gravity' as the force pulling long-term value creation into short-term optimization
summary: Luca Leonardini — strategy advisor and newsletter author on value creation — publishes a deep-dive on Ries's financial-gravity concept: the relentless pressure that turns long-term value creation into short-term financial optimization. Frames the book as the antidote most companies don't have.
blockquote: Most companies don't set out to lose their way, but they do. And they do it by simply keep following what the market rewards. Eric Ries in his new book 'Incorruptible' calls this force financial gravity: the relentless pressure that turns long-term value creation into short-term financial optimization.
